messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: service-x v2.3.0 -> canary at 10% now; feature flag `cohort_migration` currently OFF. rolling out with pin strategy: new-worker=enabled pin=version:v2.3.0
kai (eng): Copying plan from runbook — canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m soak per step. Health gates: 5xx rate, p95 latency, error budget burn.
maya (pm): Heads-up: this release toggles the migration flag for EU cohorts only. Release notes updated here: https://go/release-notes/service-x/v2.3.0 (short summary included).
alex (sre): Preflight checks done. CPU/GPU perf looks normal on canary. I'll watch logs for 5xx spikes. Alert thresholds set.
priya (eng-releases): Reminder: pinning model routing to model-id=mx-2026-06-a for the canary, fallback to mx-stable if latency>250ms. Added a safety hold at 50% that requires manual ack.
kai (eng): Command to flip to 10% cohort: `/ff toggle cohort_migration --percent 10 --scope eu --by releasebot`
deploy-bot: Executing: `/ff toggle cohort_migration --percent 10 --scope eu --by releasebot`
deploy-bot: Result: OK — cohort_migration = 10% (eu). Canary traffic shifted.
maya (pm): Noting telemetry: small uptick in user errors for cohort B — observed in dashboard. Keeping at 10% while we triage. :eyes:
alex (sre): Looking at traces — a specific downstream call to auth-cache is timing out at ~300ms for 2% of requests from cohort B. Triage in progress.
kai (eng): Rolling back cohort_migration to 0% while we confirm root cause? rollback will unpin new-worker. Thoughts?
priya (eng-releases): Agree rollback to 0% until auth-cache fix shipped. I'll prepare a short postmortem note and mark the release with holdpoint.
deploy-bot: Initiating: `/ff toggle cohort_migration --percent 0 --scope eu --by releasebot`
deploy-bot: Result: OK — cohort_migration = 0% (eu). Canary drained.
maya (pm): OK thank you. We'll hold the release. Can we pin traffic to v2.2.x stable routing until next attempt?
kai (eng): Yes routing locked to v2.2.x for traffic. I'll patch the release notes with rollback details and the bug id: BUG-4521.
alex (sre): After rollback, 5xx and latency back to baseline. I'll keep the watch for 30m then we can decide next steps.
priya (eng-releases): Added an entry in the release tracker: "v2.3.0 hold — cohort_migration rollback due to auth-cache timeouts; follow-up: bump cache TTL and retry canary on maintenance window."
maya (pm): Scheduling retry: maintenance window Fri 02:00-03:00 UTC. We'll attempt a controlled 5% to 20% ramp with extra SRE coverage.
kai (eng): I'll add an explicit pin for the test canary to prevent auto-roll when we retry. Command: `/deploy pin service-x --version v2.3.0 --until 2026-06-06T03:30Z`
deploy-bot: Pin created: service-x pinned to v2.3.0 until 2026-06-06T03:30Z.
priya (eng-releases): Linking to the preflight checklist and runbook in the retry ticket. All stakeholders tagged. :white_check_mark:
alex (sre): TL;DR: rollback done, traffic stable, retry scheduled, manual hold at 50% if needed. I'll post an incident summary after watch window.
maya (pm): Thanks all. I'll send a short customer-facing blurb post-watch if everything stays green.
kai (eng): +1, documenting the mitigation steps and exact ff toggle commands in the release notes so oncall can reproduce quickly.
deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot: release held. Use the pinned commands in thread to re-run when ready.
